Frontend: 6 new components (CMSConnectForm, CMSConnectedState, CMSSyncedPostsTable, PublishDrawer, StaleContentActions, useCMS hooks), 6 modified pages. Codex-reviewed twice (GPT-5.3-Codex: 10+10 findings, all fixed). 62 backend CMS tests + 82 frontend tests passing. Zero regressions.
constraints: Backward compatibility with existing artifacts — all Pydantic fields must have defaults
Raw SDK clients for gap analysis + content engine (no LangChain wrappers)
LiteLLM wraps all LLM calls in content engine workers/judges/agents
LangGraph >=1.0 interrupt model: check __interrupt__ in result dict, not GraphInterrupt exception
No Supabase yet — filesystem artifacts are source of truth
Default-deny middleware — all routes protected unless explicitly whitelisted
core/ cannot import from api/ — shared code goes in core/shared_tools/
DB layer is opt-in via DATABASE_URL — repos flush only, DI session generator owns commit/rollback
AuthServiceProtocol is the contract — all routers use get_auth_service dependency
LangSmith is sole tracing backend — Langfuse fully removed
Hub prompts opt-in via langsmith_use_hub=False — local Python prompts authoritative by default
pipeline_state.json stays on local filesystem — earmarked for Redis, NOT R2
Non-local StorageBackends must NOT fall back to filesystem reads (H3 rule)
environment_notes: Key deps: LangGraph >=1.0, langsmith >=0.2, litellm >=1.50, sqlalchemy[asyncio] >=2.0.30, structlog >=24.1, boto3
